Bull Run, 2nd Battle of, Va., 1862
genealogy
description: The situation in July, 1862 -- The Battle of Cedar Mountain -- On the Rappahannock -- Jackson's raid -- The pursuit of Jackson -- The Battle of Gainesville -- McDowell and Porter -- The Battle of Groveton -- Longstreet and Porter -- The Battle of Manassas -- The Battle of Chantilly -- Halleck and McClellan -- Final reflections -- Appendix A: The address to the army, and general orders -- Appendix B: Porter's night march -- Appendix C: Porter's orders and dispatches on the 29th -- Appendix D: The losses in battle -- Appendix E: The numbers of the two armies -- Appendix F: Time of the arrival of Kemper's Division -- Appendix G: Roster of the Federal and Confederate Armies at the Battle of Manassas, otherwise called the Second Battle of Bull Run, fought on Saturday, August 30, 1862
